title: Lost in Osaka's Umeda underground? This free map helps #shorts
description:
Umeda's underground malls in Osaka are famous for being a maze, and GPS doesn't work down there.

Umeda Underground Navi is a free web app: search a shop, an exit or a spot, tell it the exit number you can see (or a shop nearby), and it walks you there step by step in a first-person view.

- Whity Umeda, Diamor Osaka, Hankyu Sanbangai, ekimo Umeda, Dotica and the station passages
- 10 languages
- No download, no account: open it in your browser

https://umeda.enludus.com

Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

#osaka #japantravel #umeda #japan #traveltips
